item.title: Qianjin de Nuli Jiajiajiu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Asami
  • 発売日: 2023-03-16
  • スコア: 5.9799999999999995/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 千金的奴隸家家酒
  • 英語名: Kanemochi Ojou-sama to Dorei-gokko

あらすじ

Loss and disappointment. I was a failure, and I quit my job when I hit rock bottom.

And that’s when before me appeared my supervisor, Liu Huixi, dragging a suitcase.

“Something came up, and I can’t go home. Can I stay with you for a while…?”

She was one of the main reasons I quit. I wanted to turn her down, but the sniveling corporate worm part of me couldn’t refuse. I had no choice but to let her stay with me.
